faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for VNMKV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 16 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in VNMKV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 6 vacancies: 1 AI/ML and Data Science Lead, 1 Geospatial and Remote Sensing Specialist, 1 Robotics and IoT/Edge Computing Specialist, 1 Industry and Startup Liaison, 2 Junior Technical Fellow/ Project Associates.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for VNMKV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Application proforma attached to the notification (pages 6-7 for four posts; pages 8-10 for Industry and Startup Liaison)) and send it to Nodal Officer, Artificial Intelligence Innovation and Incubation Center (AI3C), College of Agricultural Engineering & Technology, Vasantrao Naik Marathwada Krishi Vidyapeeth, Parbhani. 431402 (M.S.), by by post or in person, to reach by 16 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 50 years (as on 2026). Relaxation: Relaxation possible in exceptional cases.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Upto Rs. 1,25,000 Consolidated for AI/ML and Data Science Lead, Upto Rs. 1,25,000 Consolidated for Geospatial and Remote Sensing Specialist, Upto Rs. 1,25,000 Consolidated for Robotics and IoT/Edge Computing Specialist, Up to Rs. 1,25,000 Consolidated for Industry and Startup Liaison, Up to Rs. 70,000 Consolidated for Junior Technical Fellow/ Project Associates.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Engineering Graduate / B.Tech, PG / PG Diploma, M.Tech/ME/PhD or MBA/M.Tech/MS in the relevant field, with 2 to 5 years of total experience depending on the post. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. AI/ML and Data Science Lead: strong programming skills (Python, Tensor Flow / PyTorch, SQL). Geospatial and Remote Sensing Specialist: hands-on experience with GIS tools (ArcGIS/QGIS). Industry and Startup Liaison: strong stakeholder management skills. Junior Technical Fellow/ Project Associates: basic knowledge in research and experimentation.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting of applications. Interview. Shortlisted candidates will be called for interview. Interview date and venue communicated to shortlisted candidates through e-mail only.

faq.answer: Purely temporary and contractual, upto 31 March, 2029; may be terminated at any time. Contract bond of Rs.100/- to be executed before joining. Must join within 10 days from the date of issue of the order, failing which the order is treated as cancelled.
